productFocus: Largest luxury hotel/resort chain in Cambodia — hotel door-lock and hardware demand
scale: Seven hotel properties across four Cambodian cities and provinces
projects: Sokha Beach Resort (391 rooms), Sokha Phnom Penh, Sokha Siem Reap
importSignal: No customs or confirmed lock-purchase claim is used. Current operation of a seven-property portfolio and hosting of major 2026 events make hotel-lock standardization or phased replacement a relevant hypothesis for procurement qualification.

evidence.signal: Sokha's current official portfolio lists seven operating hotel and resort properties across four Cambodian cities and provinces.
Cambodia's official news agency reported that Sokha Beach Resort hosted the 2026 Tourism Business Forum on 29 July 2026, confirming active operation and business-event use of the portfolio.

researchSources.label: AKP 2026 Tourism Business Forum at Sokha Beach Resort

fitReason: Large hotel group is a prime buyer of RFID/smart hotel door locks at scale
angle: Reference the actively operated multi-property portfolio and offer a three-model RFID/BLE hotel-lock package for procurement to assess across renovation, replacement and premium-room use cases.
risk: The evidence confirms current portfolio operation, not an announced lock project. The email must ask whether access-control standardization or phased replacement is relevant and must not claim a live tender. Purchasing may also run through hospitality specifiers.
